Definition: probably for the dative case of G3588; an enclitic particle of asseveration by way of contrast; in sooth:--(used only with other particles in the compound, as G2544, G3305, G5105, G5106, etc.)
BiblicalUsage: This word has no verse of its own in the Greek text. It is the particle toi, which Strong lists separately but which never stands alone in the New Testament: it survives only inside compound words, like toigaroun and toinun, where it adds an edge of asseveration, a "truly" or "in sooth."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the honest thing is to say so plainly: some dictionary words are pieces of other words, not words anyone ever spoke alone, and this is one of them.
